features.feature: Canonical root npm test completes every required member below 300000 ms in three consecutive same-material clean-clone runs.
The authoritative current baseline freezes the 45 canonical B-9812 members while bidirectional completeness incorporates every required member merged before final verification.

Parallelism is allowed only for explicitly classified compatible resources; unknown or conflicting Git common-dir, fixed path or port, runtime-lock, and main-write-lock claims fail closed or serialize.
Concurrent tasks own unique temporary roots and terminate all descendants with bounded cleanup on completion, timeout, or interruption.
Optimization preserves complete member, assertion, mutation, diagnostic, restoration, reviewer-lane, quorum, and critical-evidence inventories rather than moving or deleting assurance.
The acceptance rollout generates each logical cohort once, binds it to a digest, reuses it safely, and retains representative real dist and CLI black-box equivalence sentinels.
Incremental-context and intent-hardening retain deterministic mixed-writer, ABA, cutoff, restoration, and mutation-killing coverage while only independent shards overlap.
Canonical root npm test uses the resource-aware manifest runner, executes every current or later-merged required canonical member exactly once, and preserves focused diagnostic entrypoints.
An initial FAIL, TIMEOUT, signal exit, worker rejection, or missing terminal record remains terminal and cannot be laundered by an automatic retry.
Performance evidence records machine-readable per-member timing, process launches, critical path, utilization, lock waits, material identity, bounded output identity, and terminal outcomes.
The self-host DONE-required policy continues to execute same-material packages/main build proof before canonical root npm test and produces fresh exact command receipts.
Routine lattice validate remains distinct from opt-in DONE-required full-suite validation; external projects do not inherit the self-host cost or assurance claim.
Optimized smokes preserve compiled-dist standalone black-box behavior while redundant behavioral matrices may reuse initialized state only behind differential CLI sentinels.
High-risk implementation receives three distinct review rounds with two independent hosts per round over final material.
features.excluded_by: This remains a lifecycle review-assurance obligation enforced during REVIEW and closeout; B-9812 neither changes nor weakens it.
